M004.label: favourable
M004.quote: Thus, the influences of the 1st, 2nd, 4th, 9th, 10th and 11th are so interrelated in this horoscope that they account for the immense wealth and power the Maharaja commanded.

M012.label: favourable
M012.quote: The native is happily married to a devoted and chaste wife with religious propensities.

M020.label: favourable
M020.quote: The position of Saturn made him rich and emphasizes his fondness for spectacular demonstration.
M020.note: Raman credits the exalted 10th-house Saturn with wealth and publicity while debunking his spiritual claims; the status/standing conclusion is positive.

M028.label: favourable
M028.quote: Franco's horoscope is notable for the manner in which yogakaraka Saturn conferred the Rajayoga results in his Dasa.

M036.label: afflicted
M036.quote: The debilitation and eclipse of the 7th lord Saturn and Mars in the 8th house resulted in the death of wife.

M044.label: afflicted
M044.quote: Note Mars as lord of the 6th and Saturn as lord of the 8th both afflicting Lagna point out the direction of his destiny — incarceration and death by hanging.

M052.label: afflicted
M052.quote: Note Mars as lord of the 6th and Saturn as lord of the 8th both afflicting Lagna point out the direction of his destiny — incarceration and death by hanging.
M052.note: Hanged for murdering Gandhi; death by violent judicial execution.

M060.label: mixed
M060.quote: are excellent Dhana Yogas favouring amassing of wealth, but as lord of the 11th (Mercury) is in the 12th, again aspected by the benefic Jupiter, he divested himself of almost all his property
M060.note: Wealth amassed (also a windfall inheritance) but he gave almost all of it away to the nation.

M068.label: mixed
M068.quote: As a result of this affliction, Roosevelt was stricken with infantile paralysis at the end of Saturn Dasa.
M068.note: Same Lagna-lord-in-6th combination gave paralysis ('reduced to a wreck') and a Vipareetha Rajayoga taking him to the highest position; two-sided.

M076.label: afflicted
M076.quote: the 7th house has the influences of all the malefics — Saturn, Rahu, Ketu and Mars centered on them. This is a very significant combination making the native a real Brahmachari
M076.note: Spouse denied: lifelong celibacy, which Raman frames approvingly in a spiritual sense.

M084.label: afflicted
M084.quote: is an unfortunate combination which involved him in trying lawsuits, brought against him by the authorities for his 'obscene writings'.
M084.note: Raman also notes 'Ellis himself was not molested'; the litigation conclusion is still adverse.

M092.label: afflicted
M092.quote: That he was inconspicuous in the school and had meagre education is revealed by the 4th lord being Saturn

M108.label: afflicted
M108.quote: the native had defective sight till 1928, i.e., he could not see clearly during nights and he lost his vision completely in 1928
M108.note: Total loss of sight; Raman ties it to the afflicted 2nd and 12th (both eyes).

M116.label: afflicted
M116.quote: the 5th Bhava is rendered weak with the result no children have been born to him either by the first or the second wife.

M124.label: mixed
M124.quote: the native married a second time after the death of the first. Both marriages were fairly happy.
M124.note: First wife died; both marriages 'fairly happy' though with tiffs and a touchy wife.

M132.label: afflicted
M132.quote: These combinations explain the fact of his parents having died early.

M148.label: afflicted
M148.quote: These afflictions rendered the native issueless.
M148.note: Found at NH:11063-11064, outside the cited line window.

M156.label: afflicted
M156.quote: Domestically the poet was not happy, on account of the death of his wife and children. Of his five children, two were the survivors.

M164.label: afflicted
M164.quote: The native of Chart No. 253 has weak eyes which water under even slight strain.

M172.label: favourable
M172.quote: The subject is quite well off in life and enjoys a monthly salary of Rs. 1,500.

M180.label: mixed
M180.quote: gave Hitler immense material possessions and power. The evil side of Saturn's influence manifested in the final collapse of the dictator — especially because Saturn is in the 10th house
M180.note: Rise to supreme power and final collapse both attributed to the 10th-house Saturn.

M188.label: mixed
M188.quote: The native had 6 brothers (and sisters born) out of whom three died early in life.
M188.note: Third house good, third lord rather weak; half the siblings died early.

M204.label: favourable
M204.quote: The 9th lord occupying the constellation of the Lagna lord and aspecting the 9th house are important factors conducive to the long life of the father.
M204.note: Father died in the native's 41st year, read by Raman as long life.

M212.label: favourable
M212.quote: In Jupiter Dasa, Jupiter Bhukti, the native not only had dips in the Ganges but also in many other sacred rivers and visited a number of holy places.
M212.note: Dharma here = pilgrimage and sacred-river bathing.

M220.label: none
M220.note: Raman's 4th-house conclusions here concern education (brilliant scholar), not domestic happiness; no happiness conclusion found.

M228.label: favourable
M228.quote: Sri Chaitanya was very beautiful and was hence called Gauranga or fair-complexioned.

M236.label: favourable
M236.quote: Mars dominant in the 10th, we have indeed the General of the Army.
M236.note: Also: "rise up to the pinnacle of fame and glory" (Bhadra Yoga).

M244.label: none
M244.note: Only the timing of the father's death (1930, native aged about 34) is given; no judgment on the father's welfare or longevity.

M252.label: none
M252.note: Nothing on virility; the 7th-house conclusion is the death of his wife and domestic unhappiness.

M260.label: favourable
M260.quote: All these combined together denote immense immovable possessions.

M268.label: favourable
M268.quote: The Jupiter-Mars influence denotes property, wealth and prosperity, a happy home and peaceful and successful domestic surroundings — though the martian aspect has got its own evil effect to produce.
M268.note: Predominantly favourable with an unspecified martian caveat; first wife died (a 7th-house matter).

M276.label: none
M276.note: Raman notes he 'suffered from cancer' (site unstated) and the H3 conclusion is about siblings (sole surviving of nine); no ear/throat conclusion.

M284.label: favourable
M284.quote: It was Jupiter Dasa that enabled him to found his kingdom in the face of unparalleled difficulties
M284.note: Also: "the strength par excellence of Lagna, the 9th and 10th houses".

M292.label: afflicted
M292.quote: the presence of the karaka in the relevant house deprived the native of his father very early in life.
M292.note: Father was exalted (royal) but his longevity was curtailed; native lost him around age 4.

M300.label: afflicted
M300.quote: Ill-health and financial troubles were too much for him.

M308.label: afflicted
M308.quote: Pitrukaraka, Sun, afflicted by Rahu s association and the 9th lord being aspected by Mars, rendered the native fatherless at an early age.

M316.label: favourable
M316.quote: Note the native acquired a fine car in Jupiter Dasha Venus Bhukti and a decent house in Jupiter Dasha Mars Bhukti.
M316.note: Text labels this Chart No. 85 (born 8-8-1912); no '85-B' label in text.
